questions.question: What was the day of the week on 26 th January 1950? 26 जनवरी 1950 को सप्ताह का दिन क्या था?
questions.solution:
Last 2 digits of the year= 50

Quotient on dividing 50 by 4= 12

Date=26

Month Code= 0 (January)

Year Code= 0 (1900-1999)

Total Sum= (50+12+26+0+0) = 88

Remainder on dividing 88 by 7= 4

Day code 4 is for Thursday
